subject: 47 employees missing from July payroll
description: Client rang in, properly wound up. July run went out Tuesday and 47 people got nothing. Says nothing changed her end, same file as always, never had this before. Month end, store managers fielding calls from staff. Wants to know what we broke and when it's fixed. Mentioned a claim.

subject: Whole payroll rejected after "upgrade" - period column
description: Cust submitted the monthly file as normal, every row rejected. Insists file structure is byte identical to last month. Wants us to roll back whatever we changed.
resolution_notes: 2026.3 tightened period column validation, now has to match the run's pay period exactly. Their export was writing submission month, not pay month. Been like that for ages, tolerated before, meant they were actually paying against the wrong period without knowing. Change was in the release notes. Sent corrected column mapping, they re-exported, resubmission clean. No charge on the correction run. Took a bit of convincing but once we showed the old behaviour was mis-allocating periods, they accepted it.
root_cause: Customer export wrote the wrong period; previously tolerated, rejected from 2026.3

subject: Seasonal staff missing bank details after migration
description: Since moving to Saldo, a bunch of seasonal staff have no bank details at all, others look wrong. Asking if the migration failed.
resolution_notes: Migration file from the old provider had blank payment details for anyone whose contract had lapsed by export time, most of the seasonal pool as it turned out. Nothing failed on our side, source data was just incomplete. Built a reconciliation list, everyone missing or with a non-IBAN account, sent it over. Came back within the week, bulk imported. Told them to review migrated records in full next time, not spot check, these things only show up at the first run that touches them.
root_cause: Incomplete payment details in the migration file from the previous provider

subject: SLA credit request - rejected rows
description: Had rows rejected on a run, staff paid three days late. Wants a 10% service credit under the SLA, reckons the service failed.
resolution_notes: Checked with Commercial. Availability for the month was 99.98% against 99.9% target, so SLA met, no credit due. Explained credits are for the service being down, not for validation doing its job, section 6 covers this. Rejections were three employees whose contracts had ended before the period. Account manager offered a goodwill gesture instead, accepted. Distinction wasn't obvious to the cust, took two calls to land.
root_cause: Customer expectation: rejections treated as unavailability

subject: 20 agency staff rejected, rest of run fine
description: About twenty people on one shift rejected, everyone else paid. Asked if the file got truncated.
resolution_notes: File was complete. All twenty were agency workers set up with a placeholder bank account when onboarded in a hurry. Placeholder passed the format check, well formed account number, just not theirs. Corrected the records, ran a free correction run same afternoon. A wrong but well formed account is worse than a missing one, it actually pays someone.
root_cause: Placeholder bank accounts on hurriedly created employee records

subject: Drivers paid a day late - approved after cut-off
description: Rang to say the drivers hadn't been paid on the expected day. Wanted to know why the run didn't go out.
resolution_notes: Approved 15:40, cut-off's 14:00 for that value date, so it rolled to next business day, working as designed. Walked them through the cut-off on the run summary screen. They're late most months, this'll keep happening. Suggested moving the second driver batch a day earlier. Noted on acct.

subject: Cost centre breakdown doesn't match store figures
description: Regional manager compared the cost centre report against store level figures, a few stores out by a few thousand crowns.
resolution_notes: Differences were staff transferred between stores mid month. Payroll allocates the whole period to the CC held on the record at run time, so a transfer shows entirely against the new store. Explained, pointed them at the transfer date column in the employee export to reconcile. No product fault.
root_cause: Cost centre allocated at run time, not pro rated across transfers

subject: SFTP key rotation for the HR integration
description: Rotating the key their HR system uses to drop the payroll file.
resolution_notes: Walked through self-service key rotation (added 2026.7). New key installed, test transfer clean.

subject: Warning banner about legacy account numbers
description: Asking what the yellow banner on the run detail screen means, something about legacy account numbers.
resolution_notes: Banner flags employees still on the old domestic account format, automatic conversion's being removed. Pointed them at the export marking affected records, offered to prep a migration file. They'll look at it after the season.

subject: Supplier invoices from OSVČ doctors not matching payments
description: Big batch of invoices from contracted doctors not matching against the payments, both sides left open on the ledger.
resolution_notes: Matching runs on variable symbol, doctors' invoices carry their own numbering not the one on the payment. Set up a matching rule on amount plus counterparty account for this group. Backlog cleared. This cust has an unusually high ratio of supplier invoices to payroll.
root_cause: Variable symbol mismatch between invoice and payment

subject: Subcontractor hours appearing in payroll import
description: Site attendance export pulling in subcontracted trades who aren't their employees, import failing on unknown employee IDs.
resolution_notes: Their time tracking tool exports everyone who badged onto site, regardless of employer. Added a filter on employment status at source. Import's been clean since. VAL-011 on an unknown employee did its job here, would've paid someone else's staff otherwise.
root_cause: Attendance export not filtered to own employees

subject: Harvest season temporary staff rejected
description: Seasonal harvest workers rejected on the monthly run.
resolution_notes: Contracts entered with a start date after the pay period began, so not eligible for that run. Corrected start dates, reran. Reminded them seasonal contracts need entering before the period they cover, not at first payment.
root_cause: Contract start dates entered after the pay period

subject: Bank statements not importing since we joined
description: New cust, statements not coming through automatically, keying them in by hand.
resolution_notes: Bank connection was set up but never authorised on the bank's side, needs the account signatory not the accountant. Sent authorisation steps. Working once done. Common on new accounts.
root_cause: Bank connection never authorised by the signatory

subject: Separating client entities within our tenant
description: Practice wants staff to only see the client companies they're assigned to, not all forty.
resolution_notes: They run every client entity inside one tenant, outside normal usage, product assumes one tenant per company with permissions scoped at tenant level. Nothing configurable that gets them what they want. Escalated to their AM as a commercial conversation about per-client tenants. Still unresolved commercially, flagged on the account for renewal.
root_cause: Multi-entity usage inside a single tenant

subject: Bulk issue of invoices for the autumn campaign
description: Wants to issue a few hundred invoices at once ahead of the season.
resolution_notes: Showed the batch issue screen, 500 row limit per batch. They'll split it.

subject: DPP workers over the annual hours limit
description: Several seasonal DPP staff close to the annual hours limit, want to know what happens if they go over.
resolution_notes: Explained the 300hr annual cap per employer on DPP, going over changes the insurance treatment. Showed the hours to date column. Moved the affected people onto DPČ.

subject: Net pay wrong for the whole plant after January run
description: Says every net figure is out by a small amount vs their own numbers, wants the payment halted.
resolution_notes: 2026 statutory rate update had gone in, their spreadsheet was still on 2025 bands and the old taxpayer credit. Our figures were right. Sent the rate change note from the release. They rechecked, confirmed, payment went out on time. Annual rate change reliably kicks off two or three of these in January.
root_cause: Customer comparison built on the previous year's rates

subject: Per diem allowances on the payroll report
description: Asking if travel allowances can be shown separately on the monthly payroll summary.

subject: Run stuck in calculating
description: Run submitted this morning's been sitting in CALCULATING for twenty minutes.
resolution_notes: INC-2140, stalled calculation worker. Cleared by restart, run completed normally, no payment delayed. Confirmed back to cust same day.

subject: SFTP connection refused intermittently
description: Nightly transfer failed twice out of six attempts, host key error.
resolution_notes: Matched to INC-2103, cert rotation not applied on one gateway node. Fixed platform side. Their transfers clean since.

subject: Ski season temporary contracts not picked up
description: Winter seasonal staff at the mountain stores missing from the run.
resolution_notes: Fixed term contracts had end dates in the previous month, not extended, so not eligible. Extended and ran a free correction run. Suggested a check on contract end dates before each seasonal peak.

subject: Depreciation schedule for new equipment
description: How to set up depreciation for equipment bought under a grant.
resolution_notes: Walked through the fixed asset register and depreciation methods. Told them to confirm tax treatment of the grant with their advisor, we don't do tax advice.

subject: Payment file rejected by the bank
description: Bank refused the whole batch, sent it back.
resolution_notes: Funding account had insufficient cover at submission, PAY-102. They topped it up, resubmitted same day. Suggested checking the balance before approving, not after.
root_cause: Insufficient funds on the funding account

subject: Duplicate payment to part of the hotel staff
description: Group of employees apparently paid twice for the same period.
resolution_notes: Two runs submitted for the same period, second meant as a correction but had every employee in it, not just the rejected ones. Both approved. Recovered the duplicates via the bank where possible, the rest direct from employees. Explained a correction run should only contain the affected people. Best argument yet for reading the run summary before approving.
root_cause: Correction run submitted with the full employee list

subject: Report API timing out
description: Their shop integration pulls a sales report nightly, started returning 504.
resolution_notes: INC-2078, gateway upgrade reset the upstream timeout. Restored platform side. Suggested they page the report if it grows further.

subject: Bulk employee import overwrote cost centres
description: After an import to update salaries, everyone's cost centre got reset.
resolution_notes: Import file had the CC column included, left blank, and blank got applied as a change instead of ignored. Restored from the audit log. Preview mode landed in 2026.6 off the back of this one, now it reports what'll change before anything's written.
root_cause: Blank column in import treated as a change

subject: Export of payroll costs per construction site
description: Would like the payroll cost report broken down by site for their project accounting.

subject: Shop manager cannot log in
description: One of the shop managers is locked out.
resolution_notes: Locked after repeated failed attempts. Reset, access confirmed.

subject: Employee master migration from previous provider
description: Onboarding. Loading their existing employee records into Saldo from an export off their previous payroll provider.
resolution_notes: Imported 1,180 employee records, single export file. Old domestic account format throughout, accepted and converted on the way in. Reconciled headcount and payment details against their own list, matched. Flagged to the cust that the accounts came across in legacy format. First live run went clean.

subject: Active headcount on the invoice looks high
description: Queried the number of active employees they'd been billed for.
resolution_notes: Count includes anyone eligible for at least one run in the month, so seasonal staff who worked a single week are in there. Explained, sent the breakdown. Billed correctly.

subject: Invoice queried again - seasonal headcount
description: Third quarter running they've questioned the employee count on the invoice.
resolution_notes: Same explanation as previous quarters. Their headcount genuinely swings by several hundred across the season, billing counts anyone eligible for a run. Proposed to their AM that we agree an averaging arrangement at renewal, this eats support time every quarter.
root_cause: Seasonal headcount against per employee billing

subject: Accrual for unbilled project work
description: How to post an accrual for work delivered but not invoiced yet at period end.
resolution_notes: Showed the accrual journal template and the reversal at the start of the next period.

subject: Drivers rejected - hours out of range
description: A dozen drivers rejected with an hours error.
resolution_notes: Their export had summed two pay periods into one row, pushed hours above the 400hr ceiling. Split correctly, resubmitted. VAL-021 caught what would've been a double payment.
root_cause: Two periods summed into one row in the customer export

subject: Bulk import of supplier invoices
description: Asked again whether incoming invoices can be imported in bulk instead of keyed in.
resolution_notes: No bulk import for incoming invoices yet, on the roadmap, not committed. Suggested the scanning integration as a partial fix. Second time they've asked, it's the biggest part of their monthly close.

subject: Shift allowance not calculated for night shift
description: Night shift premium missing for a group of production staff.
resolution_notes: Allowance configured on one CC but not the other after the shop floor got reorganised. Corrected the config, reran. Free correction run.
root_cause: Allowance not configured on a new cost centre

subject: Statutory payroll report for the labour office
description: Which report covers the quarterly submission.
resolution_notes: Pointed them at the statutory reports section and the right form. Reminded them we produce the report, don't file it for them.

subject: Confirmation of the discounted rate
description: Checking the rate on the invoice matches the contract.
resolution_notes: Confirmed the contracted rate, 52 CZK per active employee, against Schedule A. Invoice correct.

subject: Slovak payments arrived a day late
description: Staff paid a day later than the value date given to them.
resolution_notes: INC-2091. Payments routed to the new Slovak banking partner missed that partner's earlier cut-off, routing config still had the original partner's time in it. Corrected platform side. Apologised, no charge, nothing since.
root_cause: Platform - cut-off not updated for the second banking partner

subject: API token for the shop integration
description: Needs a token for their e-shop platform to post orders into invoicing.
resolution_notes: Issued a token scoped to invoicing. Sent the integration guide.

subject: Treatment centre staff on the wrong cost centre
description: Staff shared between the hotels and the treatment centre are all landing on one hotel.
resolution_notes: Each employee carries one CC, shared staff had been put on whichever hotel hired them. Split them onto the treatment centre. Anyone genuinely split across sites needs a rule at their end, payroll allocates whole not fractional.
root_cause: Shared staff assigned to a single cost centre

subject: VAT ledger export format for the advisor
description: Their tax advisor wants the VAT ledger in a specific layout.
resolution_notes: Sent the standard export. Advisor's layout isn't one we produce, suggested they map it once at their end.

subject: Migration from previous provider - accounts in old format
description: Onboarding. Previous provider's export holds bank accounts in the old domestic format, asked if that'd be a problem.
resolution_notes: Imported as supplied, accounts converted automatically during validation, first run paid clean. Told the cust the records came across in legacy format and that they should plan to convert them, automatic conversion won't be there forever. No action taken at the time.

subject: Fuel card costs against driver payroll
description: Whether fuel card spend can be reported alongside driver payroll cost.
resolution_notes: Not in payroll reporting. Suggested reporting off the ledger where both sit. No product change.

subject: Statement import stopped after bank changed their format
description: Automatic statement import's been failing since the bank changed something.
resolution_notes: Bank switched statement format version. Updated the parser config for that bank. Backfilled the missing days.

subject: Payslip not visible for one employee
description: Employee says they can't see their payslip.
resolution_notes: Had two records from the migration, one inactive, signing in against the inactive one. Merged the records.

subject: New starter needs access to invoicing only
description: Adding a new administrator with restricted permissions.
resolution_notes: Created the user with the invoicing role. Confirmed no payroll visibility.

subject: Three employees rejected on the July run
description: Three people weren't paid on the run submitted this month, everyone else went through fine.

subject: Posting the grain harvest to stock
description: How to post harvested grain into stock at year end.
resolution_notes: Walked through own production posting. Told them to confirm valuation with their advisor.

subject: Shop assistant hours entered against the wrong shop
description: Hours for two assistants went to the wrong shop.
resolution_notes: Corrected the CC on the two records. Reporting reissued. Pay unaffected.

subject: Credit notes for returned goods not reducing the ledger
description: Returns are being credited but the receivables balance isn't moving.
resolution_notes: Credit notes had been issued without linking to the original invoices, so both sat open. Linked the existing ones, showed them how to issue against an invoice.
root_cause: Credit notes not linked to source invoices

subject: Rejected rows with no obvious reason
description: Four rows rejected, couldn't tell why from the report.
resolution_notes: Rejection report gave the code but not the column, hard to see the personal number was malformed on those four. Explained, corrected, reran free. Raised internally that the report should name the failing column, added later in 2026.8.
root_cause: Malformed personal numbers; unclear rejection report

subject: Adding a second bank account
description: Connecting a second account used for the treatment centre.
resolution_notes: Connected, authorised. Statements importing.

subject: Late submission again, wants the cut-off moved
description: Asked if their cut-off can be extended, they're consistently submitting late.
resolution_notes: Cut-off's fixed by the banking partner, can't move it per customer. Went through their process instead, second driver batch waits on per diem approval which lands the day of the cut-off. Suggested submitting the batch without allowances, adding them as a free correction run. They're considering it.
root_cause: Customer process, not a product limitation

subject: Cost per delivery team for client billing
description: Wants payroll cost by delivery team to support their own client billing.
resolution_notes: Their CCs already map to delivery teams, standard CC report gives it. Showed them where.

subject: Invoice address change
description: Company moved office, needs the billing address updated.
resolution_notes: Updated. Next invoice carries the new address.

subject: Password reset
description: Locked out after holiday.
resolution_notes: Reset.

subject: Cash register takings posting
description: How to post daily cash takings from the shops.
resolution_notes: Showed the cash journal and daily summary posting. Suggested one posting per shop per day.

subject: Hours file from the HR system missing a store
description: One store's hours didn't come through, those staff left out of the run.
resolution_notes: HR export had a filter on active locations, not updated when the store reopened after refurb. Corrected at their end. Ran a free correction run for the affected staff.
root_cause: Location filter in the customer's HR export

subject: Chart of accounts differs between client entities
description: Their client companies use different charts of accounts, consolidated reporting isn't usable.
resolution_notes: Consolidation across entities with different charts isn't something the product does, assumes one chart per tenant. Suggested aligning the charts where possible. Same root issue as their single tenant setup generally.
root_cause: Multi-entity usage inside a single tenant

subject: On-call allowance for doctors
description: How to enter on-call allowances that vary week to week.
resolution_notes: Enter as a bonus on the monthly input file. Showed the column.

subject: Cold store shift premium wrong after reorganisation
description: Premium applied at the old rate for one section.
resolution_notes: Rate updated on three of four CCs. Corrected the fourth, reran. Free correction run.
root_cause: Rate not updated on all cost centres

subject: Year to date labour cost by production section
description: Asking if YTD labour cost can be shown by section without exporting each month separately.
